entry.title: [NEW] MAL-2026-11992: Malicious code in workbench-browser-server (npm)
entry.content:
Malicious code in workbench-browser-server (npm)

Aliases: GHSA-63m5-c696-rwrc

Affected:

  • workbench-browser-server

npm/workbench-browser-server is affected by the large-scale, self-propagating npm supply-chain worm of 2026-08-04 (the "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again" wave) — the same campaign that began with the compromise of the keyv and cacheable maintainer account. The listed version(s) were trojanized and republished by the worm after it reached an npm publish token belonging to a maintainer in this namespace; the payload enumerates every package a stolen token controls and republishes each with the same hook, so many packages under this scope were poisoned in the same short window.
